tests.name: Terminal vs. Shell Architectural Distinction
tests.description: Verifies that the learner correctly identifies the terminal emulator as the display/input window and the shell as the command interpreter and process execution engine.
tests.failure_message: Terminal and shell definitions confused. The terminal is the GUI display window handling keystrokes and pixels; the shell is the interpreter program (e.g. bash, zsh) that parses tokens and runs commands.

tests.name: Deconstruct `grep` Command Tokens
tests.description: Verifies that 'grep -i -n "FATAL" /var/log/api-gateway/error.log' is correctly parsed into executable 'grep', flags ['-i', '-n'], and positional arguments ['FATAL', '/var/log/api-gateway/error.log'].
tests.failure_message: Command anatomy parsing failed for grep. Remember: 'grep' is the program, '-i' and '-n' are options modifying behavior, and 'FATAL' and the file path are positional arguments.

tests.name: Deconstruct `tail` and `curl` Commands
tests.description: Verifies accurate decomposition for 'tail -n 50 /var/log/api-gateway/access.log' and 'curl -s -v --connect-timeout 5 https://api.internal/health'.
tests.failure_message: Command anatomy failed for tail or curl. Ensure option flags and values (like '-n 50' and '--connect-timeout 5') are distinguished from target arguments (like URLs and file paths).

tests.name: Clean Stdout Overwrite Redirection (`>`)
tests.description: Verifies that health check stdout is redirected with '>' to '/tmp/health.txt' with overwrite mode.
tests.failure_message: Redirection challenge 1 failed. The single greater-than operator (>) redirects standard output (1) to a file in overwrite mode.

tests.name: Historical Audit Append Redirection (`>>`)
tests.description: Verifies that audit telemetry is redirected with '>>' to '/var/log/audit.log' in append mode.
tests.failure_message: Redirection challenge 2 failed. The double greater-than operator (>>) appends standard output without truncating existing log history.

tests.name: Five-Stage Linear Log Triage Sequence
tests.description: Verifies that the incident triage pipeline follows the exact 5-stage sequential processing order: cat -> grep -> sort -> uniq -> head.
tests.failure_message: Pipeline stage order is incorrect. The data flow must follow: cat (read log) -> grep (filter errors) -> sort (group identical) -> uniq (count occurrences) -> head (extract top 5).
